messages:
Alex (Growth): Heads-up — launch next Tue 9am PT. Need final adsets for search + retarget, and inbound routing to the webinar team. Who can own creative swaps?
Mia (Paid): I can own the adset reshuffle. Plan: shift 20% budget from prospecting search to retargeting for the first 48h, then revert if CPA > target.
Devon (Creative): Working on 2 new hero banners and a short 15s webinar teaser vid. Will drop assets by EOD Fri.
Sara (Demand): For messaging, prioritize ‘real-world latency/cost benchmarks’ angle + CW testimonial. Keeps QA thread simple.
Mia (Paid): For search: pausing broad DSAs, add exact and phrase for "LLM inference latency" + "inference platform". Also create an ad variant with webinar CTA vs whitepaper CTA A/B.
Alex (Growth): Good. Mia — can you add UTM params so we can route webinar signups differently? Need utm_campaign=webinar_launch_0326 and utm_content={creative_id}.
Mia (Paid): Will do. Proposed final UTM string: ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_launch_0326&utm_content={adset}_{creative}
Devon (Creative): Uploaded two hero images to /assets/marketing/webinar/ — names: hero_latency_v1.png, hero_latency_v2.png. Short video: teaser_15s_v1.mp4 (30MB).
Sara (Demand): Inbound routing: signups with utm_content containing "webinar" should go to SDR queue A, those from whitepaper CTA go to SDR queue B. Ryan can you confirm routing?
Ryan (Sales Ops): On it. Will set up the following rule in HubSpot: if utm_campaign == webinar_launch_0326 AND utm_content contains "webinar" => owner: SDR_Webinar_A, SLA: 24h. If utm_content contains "whitepaper" => SDR_Content_B. Also add tag: "paid_search_launch_0326".
Ryan (Sales Ops): Quick note — need consistent form hidden field "creative_id" so we can map creative performance. Can Marketing add that to the registration form?
Alex (Growth): Devon can you add a hidden input labeled creative_id populated by the ad's final ID via landing script?
Devon (Creative): Yep, I'll add the snippet. Example to insert in the form page: ```<input type="hidden" name="creative_id" id="creative_id"> <script>const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search);document.getElementById('creative_id').value=params.get('utm_content')||'';</script>```
Mia (Paid): Budget pacing note: set day1 cap to 35% of daily budget for initial burst, reduce to baseline 70% on day2. Using automated rules: if CPA > $150 for 12h, pause adset.
Alex (Growth): Also add a KPI check at 48h for creative swap: if webinar CTR < 0.7% swap to hero_v2 + teaser_15s_v1.
Sara (Demand): For retargeting lists: 7d engaged, 14d engaged, and past demo viewers. Use layered frequency cap: 3 ads/day max.
Mia (Paid): I'll set audiences: Audience_A_7d, Audience_B_14d, Audience_C_demo_viewers. Retarget bids +15% vs prospecting.
Devon (Creative): FYI creative note — hero_v2 has stronger CTA and new testimonial overlay. Share preview: https://example.com/preview/hero_v2 (internal only).
Alex (Growth): campaign-bot, schedule the campaign create at 08:45 PT to allow last-min checks, and remind @Mia @Devon @Ryan at 08:30.
campaign-bot: Reminder set — campaign create scheduled for 2436865800 (2026-03-26 08:45 PT). Ping at 2436865500 (08:30 PT) to @Mia @Devon @Ryan.
Mia (Paid): I'll monitor first 3 hours and post hourly pulse in this thread. 
Sara (Demand): I'll update the webinar registration page copy with the benchmark headline and the demo CTA by Monday.
Alex (Growth): Great — final checklist: creative files in CDN, utm & hidden field wired, HubSpot routing rules by Ryan, automated CPA pause rules, initial budget shift to retarget. If anyone hits blockers call out here. :thumbsup:
Mia (Paid): All set on my end unless the CDN upload has issues.
Ryan (Sales Ops): HubSpot rules prepped, will test on staging today.
Devon (Creative): Assets uploaded and form snippet committed to staging branch: `gh pr 421`.
Sara (Demand): Copy pushed to staging. QA pass scheduled Mon 10am PT.
Alex (Growth): Thanks team — will reconvene Monday after QA.
